info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Customer Savings Account-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the establishment of savings accounts for customers within the banking system. It empowers financial institutions to efficiently manage customer savings, providing a seamless onboarding experience. Typical consumers of this API include banks and credit unions looking to enhance their banking services for clients. By using this API, organizations can promote customer loyalty and drive personal savings growth.

post.summary: Create a Savings Account for a Customer
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new savings account for a specific customer, identified by their unique customer ID. When successfully executed, it will generate a new savings account associated with that customer.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new savings account for the specified customer (CUST-100045). It should include all the necessary details required for account creation.
